_comment: Case Snapshot fields for the guided consultation (CR-001). The server reads this file and sends it to the app with each consultation, so labels, questions and chips change without an app update. text: none | optional | required | number. statuses: which of not_known, not_yet_asked, not_applicable the form offers (skipped is only set by 'Skip remaining'). aliases: other field names that mean the same thing; a case-specific question about any of them is dropped as a duplicate. always: asked for every case; every other field is asked only when the case check (the extraction call) says it would change the plan for this case, and is otherwise offered as optional.

fields.label: Age
